name: Buffalo Laser Class Association
tagline: One-design Laser racing and community for Buffalo sailors
_comment_email: This single address is the club's public contact email, shown in the footer and on the About page. Change it to your real club email.
_comment_results: Each season has a label (shown in the page's dropdown) and a published-to-web CSV url from the results spreadsheet's 'Website' tab. NEWEST SEASON GOES FIRST (it becomes the default shown). An empty list shows a friendly 'results coming soon' message. See WEBSITE_MANAGER_GUIDE.md for how to add a season.
_comment_social: Optional social links shown in the footer. Leave a value empty ("") to hide that link. We are NOT adding any social accounts in Phase 1 — these are here so a future board member can switch one on by pasting a URL.
